name: Podhradí (Cheb District, Czechia)
description: A blue central panel bearing a white tower on a grey rock with two crossed flags of red and white and red, white and black, between hoist and fly stripes of white and red.
history: Czech municipal flags are granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Parliament and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.

features.role: white and red edging stripes at hoist and fly
